terms.meaning: A fast development server and build tool for web frontends.
A local server that serves the app while it is being developed.
Checking files on a timer to detect changes.
A numbered channel on a computer that a server listens on.

sections.name: File setup
sections.title: Development server settings
sections.what: Sets the React plugin, the listening address and port, and the file watching method.
sections.why: Likely reason: makes the app reachable from containers or other devices during development.
sections.watch_out: Do not use these settings for a public deployment.

summary: Configures the Vite development server: React support, port 5173, reachable from other machines, and polling for file changes.
purpose: Controls how the frontend runs during development.
why: Likely reason: binding to all network addresses lets other devices or containers reach the server, and polling helps detect file changes in some setups.
how: Loads the React plugin, then sets the server to listen on all addresses at port 5173 and to check files by polling.
inputs: Source files and the command npm run dev.
risks: Listening on all addresses exposes the dev server to anyone on the same network, with no password. Polling uses more processor time.
debug: If the page cannot be reached, confirm the port and that the server is running. If changes do not show, confirm polling is on.
